cards.title: Application & Business Flow Overview
items: End-to-End Fund Transfer Lifecycle: Visualizes the complete operational journey from initial customer authentication to final double-entry ledger settlement.
Solvency Gatekeeping: Verifies that the customer's available spendable balance (>= transfer amount) before any soft holds are created or 2FA challenges dispatched.
Dual-Path Risk Architecture: Automatically routes low-risk everyday retail transfers (<= ₱50,000) straight through, while high-value transfers (> ₱50,000) enter an asynchronous 2FA soft hold saga.

cards.title: Path A vs Path B Risk Threshold Engine
items: Path A (Standard <= ₱50k): Instant straight-through processing (STP) executed within sub-85 millisecond latency with direct sender debit and recipient credit.
Path B (High-Value > ₱50k): Core Mutation Engine places an atomic 'soft hold' on spendable balance, transitioning the record to PENDING_VERIFICATION.
Out-of-Band 2FA Challenge: Notification Service streams a customer.otp Kafka event; dispatches a 6-digit numeric OTP via MailHog SMTP (:8025 / :1025) backed by a 5-minute Redis token TTL.

cards.title: Failure Isolation & Compensation
items: Solvency Rejection: If balance is insufficient, transaction is aborted immediately with HTTP 422 ('Insufficient Available Balance'); zero funds locked or fees charged.
OTP Verification Loop: Customers have up to 3 entry attempts; invalid entries return a retry prompt directly within the portal modal.
Failed / Expired 2FA: After 3 failed attempts or 5-minute TTL expiry, soft hold is released immediately, spendable balance restored, and status marked FAILED.

cards.title: Committed Settlement & Audit Trail
items: Master Ledger Commit: Both Path A and verified Path B converge into COMMITTED status in the master core banking ledger.
Real-Time Customer Advice: Web and Mobile dashboard balances update immediately over Server-Sent Events (SSE) / WebSocket.
Permanent Audit Record: Official HTML transaction receipt delivered to customer inbox via MailHog; immutable cryptographic records persisted into PostgreSQL audit vault & Temenos T24 CBS.
